description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing leave entitlement data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting leave entitlements, along with validation rules and openAPI documentation annotations.
external_methods: OrangeHRM\(any external method calls occurring within the class methods, such as service methods)

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee leave entitlements, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave entitlement by ID, returning its details in the specified model format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave entitlements based on filter parameters such as employee number, leave type, date range, and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates new leave entitlement(s), either individually or in bulk assigned to multiple employees.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave entitlement identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes leave entitlements specified by an array of IDs, with access and dependency checks.
